items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My mother’s eldest sister – because she was the second girl – her name was Viva.

ctx.x: Farazil. Now, the girl’s names were a little bit better. My mother’s eldest sister – because she was the second girl – her name was Viva. My mother’s name was Earle. The next daughter’s name was – oh man, it’s – Baymeta.
